featured.title: B2B Jewellery Marketplace
featured.description: A B2B platform where retailers browse jewellery catalogs and place wholesale orders. Built the Flutter app with order management, catalog, and real-time tracking features.
points: Implemented seamless OTP auto-fill authentication reducing manual input friction for end users
Integrated Google Maps API to dynamically display client office locations with real-time rendering
Architected and built a multi-language onboarding flow triggered for first-time users post splash screen
Refactored product category UI from a toggle button to a TabBar system supporting Bulk, Mass and Single product flows
Integrated Bulk Product Listing API with deep navigation to product detail pages including full data binding
Designed and developed Coupon Card UI on product detail page with complete backend API integration
Built interactive Weight Range selector with dynamic quantity controls (increase/decrease) backed by API
Independently designed Home page screens in Figma and implemented Shop by Seller and Similar Products sections with API integration
Integrated Retry Payment flow on Order page handling edge cases for failed transactions
Developed Seller-side product filtering system with advanced weight-based filter options and API integration

featured.title: Cosmino
featured.tagline: Early-stage startup app built from scratch
featured.description: Building the core Flutter application for an early-stage startup, working closely with founders on product features and Firebase backend integration.
points: Developed and maintained production-grade Flutter features for a large-scale EdTech application serving Android and iOS platforms
Implemented complete onboarding journey including multi-step user registration, profile setup and personalized learning preferences
Built subscription purchase and membership workflows with secure payment integration and entitlement management
Developed live session modules enabling users to discover, join and manage scheduled educational events
Implemented wallet, coupon and promotional offer features with seamless backend API integration
Integrated Firebase services including Authentication, Cloud Messaging and Analytics to improve user engagement and application monitoring
Designed and implemented responsive UI screens from Figma, ensuring pixel-perfect layouts across multiple device sizes
Integrated RESTful APIs using clean architecture principles with efficient state management, error handling and loading states
Optimized application performance by refactoring existing modules, reducing unnecessary rebuilds and improving overall user experience
Collaborated closely with backend developers, UI/UX designers and QA teams to deliver production-ready features within sprint timelines
Managed Play Store and App Store release cycles including build generation, testing and production deployments
Implemented event tracking and user behavior analytics using Amplitude to measure screen views, user interactions and feature engagement
